name: Let Clanging Iron Coins Fall and Halt Right at Its Feet...
desc:
The greedy Weasel Thieves are lured only by the tinkling of Iron Coins.
Pick up an iron coin and throw it at the fleeing Weasel Thieves to make them stop in their tracks.
